name: code-review trigger queries
description: Should trigger when asked to review an EDS pull request, branch, diff or own changes before a PR; near misses are implementing a block change (building-blocks / CDD), writing or running tests and browser validation (testing-blocks), fixing lint, non-EDS reviews, finding pages that use a block (find-test-content), changelog summaries and dev-server start (aem-cli).

queries.query: Can you review this pull request before I merge it? https://github.com/adobe/aem-boilerplate/pull/412 It changes the cards block and a couple of styles.
Review the changes on my `feature/hero-video` branch against `main` and tell me what's wrong with them. Blocks and scripts are touched.
I'm done with the cards CTA change. Before I open the PR, do a self-review of my uncommitted changes and list anything a reviewer would flag.
Our team lead wants EDS-specific review of everything in this diff: block JS, block CSS, head.html and package.json. What would you flag?
Review PR 87 on our Edge Delivery site: check block structure, CSS and JS patterns, Lighthouse performance and accessibility, and tell me if it's safe to approve.
Give a second pair of eyes to the diff I just staged: it adds a countdown to the hero block and a tracking snippet. Findings with file and line, please.
A teammate opened a PR adding an accordion block. I'm the reviewer; go through the diff and write up the problems.
Review the open PR on this repo and draft the review comments with file:line for each issue. Don't post anything yet.
Add an optional CTA link as a third cell to the `cards` block and make sure existing cards without it still render.
The `columns` block is finished. Add the unit and E2E tests it needs.
I changed `blocks/hero/hero.css`. Check it in the browser at a few viewport sizes and run lint before I open the PR.
`npm run lint` fails on `blocks/cards/cards.css` with a stylelint error. Fix it.
Review this pull request for our Python data pipeline: it adds a retry wrapper around the S3 client. Anything wrong with the error handling?
Review my Java OSGi service change for AEM as a Cloud Service: does it follow the Sling Model best practices?
Which pages on our site already use the `hero` block, and with which variants?
Summarize what changed in the last five commits on main for the footer block. I only want a changelog, not a review.
Start the local dev server for this project and tell me the URL.
